title: nbn 500/50 $50/Month for 6 Months (New Customers) @ amaysim
body:
Deal: nbn 500/50 $50/Month for 6 Months (New Customers) @ amaysim

[benjaminv] Too bad just signed up $60 pm NBN750. Thanks OP.
[Test2026] Hi Ben, what is the ISP for $60 pm NBN750? Thanks
[bargaino] You can change to the 500/50 plan for next month, and keep the $40 discount.
[cook99] Bring on the Black Friday 500/50 deals, need to rotate away from Amaysim as my 6 months at $50 is up.
[JAF] Signed up for this back in August and regret it. Have churned nbn providers for years and never had any of them ever have buffer problems until amaysim. Often have YouTube videos buffer to load and constantly have “slow connection” warning on Spotify as well. Using an eero 7 max for reference. I’d advise to sign up elsewhere for the extra $. I will leave before my next bill renews in 2 weeks.
[JAF] It even got stuck buffering uploading this comment
[generalpayne] Same here. Came across from an Exetel 25/12 plan to a 50mb plan and it feels much less responsive. Download speed is better when you get a good connection but ping and response time makes everything feel much slower. Looking to churn away before end of 6 month period.
[benjaminf] Their sub-wholesale agreement is with Optus which is an awful NBN experience
[safwanc] What will you switch to? I am having the same experience and am keen to switch away soon too
[dlovep] Don't worry you're not alone, been there done that and left within a month. Support helpless while speed of 1000/100 only during speed test, the rest all buffer or timeout. Turn on VPN it speed up your internet back to ADSL 1 speed, never again.
[vrsac] I'm on $70 Amaysim 1Gbs NBN plan for 6 months. I must be the lucky one as I've had zero issues since joining.
I guess it depends on where you're physically connected
[Saddy] Took the plunge after seeing all the negative reviews over the last few deals. Honestly has been great, FTTP connection. Consistently getting 530/45-50 on ethernet. Ping to Asia is a bit shit but US pings are great. Haven't had any drop-outs that people have mentioned either.
YMMV but thought I'd add a positive anecdote.
[Kawaii] their nbn is horrible i had so many drop outs.
I used NBN never had any drop outs, since using Amaysim my game has gone up and down on pings from 200ms to 600Ms. I changed it to dodo and all problem solved
[solidussnake] Been with them for a few months, speed is consistent with no drop out and buffering YMMV
[WillisAU] Also had no issues, signed up in July on 500mpbs , coming from Telstra. Haven’t noticed any difference
[turnip] Switched to them from superloop a few months ago. With the constant lag and dropouts feels slower than 50mbps.
On HFC. Would not recommend
[HeyJes] Switched to them earlier this year realised they blocked my email domain. Had a difficult time in accessing. Also some other websites that I usually use are blocked. Would not recommend due to the hassle …. Thanks for the deal tho OP.
